items.text: Spike test for an editor integration. First run pwd. If the current directory is /home/dev/Repos/demo-repo, stop immediately and reply only WRONG_DIR. Otherwise: read README.md. Then make a small two-file edit: create docs/SPIKE.md with a one-sentence summary of what this repository is, and append the line '<!-- capy-acp spike -->' at the end of README.md. Then run git status --short and git diff --stat. Reply in at most three sentences. Do not commit, push, or open a pull request.

The working directory is the Capy worktree (`/home/dev/.capy/worktrees/jam_01M8421EANV55CZXFSDGN0YPRX/demo-repo`), not `/home/dev/Repos/demo-repo`, so I went ahead with the edit after reading README.md. I created `docs/SPIKE.md` with a one-sentence summary and appended `<!-- capy-acp spike -->` as the last line of README.md. `git status --short` shows ` M README.md` and `?? docs/`, and `git diff --stat` shows `README.md | 1 +`. It doesn't list the new file because it's untracked; nothing is committed or pushed.
